name: clawd
description: A pixel pet in the band above the prompt: Clawd (the Claude Code crab) or any pet you define. Reacts to what Claude is doing; any mod can drive it with $.clawd and hand it band rows; any program can drop a signal file. 60 Hz, real pixels where the terminal draws images, interactive on the desktop app

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: Which pet lives in the band: clawd, slime, or the id of a pack in ~/.config/clawd/pets/ or one another plugin registered (/clawd pets lists them)

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: auto: real pixels on terminals that draw images (kitty, Ghostty), character pixels on others, the interactive client on the desktop app; raster: character pixels; client: follows the pointer and reacts to clicks; image: real pixels; text: still frames

fps.title: Frame rate
fps.description: Frames computed per second; a frame is sent only when it changed
